essence: This practice bestows both protective vitality and complete accomplishment.
The prescribed mantra is the utterance of obeisance to Lord Dakṣiṇāmūrti beginning with the sacred syllable.
Reciting the wisdom word in the wisdom place produces a fruit corresponding to that name.
The mantra furnished with two seed syllables becomes effective for practitioners of the left path.
The presiding deity of the mantra is the glorious great god named Dakṣiṇāmūrti.
